title: 第19章 苦海种金莲第20章 你真该死
slug: 真心待你反被弃转娶圣女你悔啥
lines: read2（）;没有迟疑，辰南将所有宝物全部放入三世铜棺。
其中包括了那两枚下品圣丹。
很快，价值四千万灵石的宝物，被炼化成了一股磅礴浩瀚的本源之气。
“辰南，你现在有两个选择。”
“一个是将所有的本源之气凝练成本源真气，提升境界，这些本源之气，应该能够助你提升到轮海境九重。”
“第二个选择，就是用本源之气来解开荒古圣体的第二道枷锁，但所需本源之气无法计算，最后的境界提升也许微乎其微。”
棺爷的声音响起，给辰南提供了两种选择。
若是普通武者，没有天道枷锁，自然不必多想，直接一路提升就行了。
但辰南的荒古圣体却是十分特殊。
在荒古时代，这本是世间最顶级的特殊体质，号称肉身无双，堪比帝体。
但今古时代，天地法则变化，荒古圣体遭到天妒，降下十道枷锁束缚其成长。
辰南想要变强，除了本源之气外，最重要的便是打破天道枷锁。
开脉大典上，辰南展现出了轮海境一重的实力，却被世人误以为是紫薇圣主相助。
如今既然有机会解开第二道天道枷锁，辰南自然不会错过。
“棺爷，我选择解开第二道枷锁！”
辰南迅速做出了决定。
棺爷只说了一个字，旋即磅礴的本源之气便涌入辰南的体内。
这一次的本源之气极其磅礴，以辰南如今的实力都承受不住，感觉身体仿佛要被撑爆了。
辰南咬牙坚持，浑身发光。
许久之后，九道虚幻的枷锁在辰南的身上浮现而出，正是天道枷锁。
雄浑无比的本源之气，浩浩荡荡的冲击着第二道枷锁。
随着本源之气的冲击，第二道枷锁摇摇欲坠，最终彻底崩碎。
哗啦！
第二道枷锁解开之际，辰南的丹田中神光万道，雷电交织，怒涛汹涌，海啸连天，声势十分浩大，称得上是惊世骇俗。
开辟丹田，凝聚苦海，这便是轮海境。
之前的辰南只是开辟了丹田，但苦海沉寂。
现在他解开第二道枷锁，终于凝聚出了苦海，而且还是金色苦海，生机旺盛，澎湃惊人。
辰南忽然发现了什么。
只见在他的苦海之中，一株神纹流转的金色莲花自海中生出，生机勃勃，绚烂夺目。

read2(); Without hesitation, Chen Nan put all the treasures into the bronze coffin of the third generation.
Including those two low-grade holy pills.
Soon, the treasure worth 40 million spiritual stones was refined into a majestic and vast source of energy.
"Chen Nan, you have two choices now."
"One is to condense all the original energy into the original source energy to improve your realm. These original energy should be able to help you ascend to the ninth level of the Wheel and Sea Realm."
"The second option is to use the original energy to unlock the second shackles of the ancient holy body, but the required original energy cannot be calculated, and the final improvement in realm may be minimal."
The coffin master's voice sounded, providing Chen Nan with two options.
If you are an ordinary warrior without the shackles of heaven, you don't need to think too much and just improve all the way.
But Chen Nan’s ancient holy body is very special.
In the ancient times, this was the top special physique in the world. It was said that the physical body was unparalleled and comparable to the imperial body.
But in the modern and ancient times, the laws of heaven and earth have changed, and the ancient holy body was jealous of heaven, and ten shackles were dropped to restrain its growth.
If Chen Nan wants to become stronger, in addition to the original energy, the most important thing is to break the shackles of heaven.
At the Pulse Opening Ceremony, Chen Nan showed the strength of the first level of the Wheel Sea Realm, but was mistakenly thought to be the help of Holy Master Ziwei.
Now that there is an opportunity to unlock the second shackles of heaven, Chen Nan will naturally not miss it.
"Master Coffin, I choose to release the second shackles!"
Chen Nan made a decision quickly.
"Okay!"
Master Coffin only said one word, and immediately the majestic energy of origin poured into Chen Nan's body.
This time, the original energy was extremely majestic. Even with Chen Nan's current strength, he couldn't bear it. He felt as if his body was about to burst.
Chen Nan gritted his teeth and persisted, his whole body glowing.
After a long time, nine illusory shackles appeared on Chen Nan's body, which were the shackles of heaven.
The extremely powerful original energy impacted the second shackles mightily.
With the impact of the original energy, the second shackles were on the verge of collapse and finally completely shattered.
Wow!
When the second shackles were released, there were thousands of divine lights in Chen Nan's dantian, thunder and lightning intertwined, raging waves, and tsunamis reaching the sky. The momentum was very huge and could be called shocking to the world.
Opening up the Dantian and condensing the sea of ​​suffering is the realm of the Wheel and Sea.
Before, Chen Nan only opened up his Dantian, but the sea of ​​suffering was silent.
Now he untied the second shackles and finally condensed the sea of ​​suffering, and it was also a golden sea of ​​suffering, full of vitality and astonishingly surging.
"This is..."
Chen Nan suddenly discovered something.
In his sea of ​​suffering, a golden lotus with flowing divine patterns emerged from the sea, full of vitality and dazzling.
